'''Gez Addar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] engineer stationed on [[Makeb]] during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. He examined the [[The Ark|Ark]], a massive [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]] built by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="Expert">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Consulting the Expert|Makeb}}</ref>
